entities.summary: Alexander "Sascha" Zverev is a German professional tennis player and the current world No. 4. He has been ranked as high as world No. 2 in men's singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP), achieved in June 2022. Zverev has won 24 ATP Tour–level titles in singles and three in doubles, and has been runner-up at three majors. His most notable achievements include a gold medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics and titles at the 2018 and the 2021 ATP Finals.
